source: User transcription of ruler measurements in dataset/instruments/c13534/captures/2026-10-30_photo_01/raw
user_statement: 9833: 34 cm width for whole tower, 22.5cm for door, 11.5cm for remaining narrow strip, with +-0.5cm for allowance since the door is not closed fully and have a small gap; 9831/9834: 26.7cm right side 9834: 28cm; C: front width hard to measure, its not flat

widths.allowance_reason: Door not fully closed; small gap included in the observation.
widths.interpretation: Transverse widths from the straight ruler in IMG_9833; door width is not distance along the curved front surface.
widths.constraint: Nominal tower width equals door width plus control strip width. Treat the allowance as a fitting tolerance, not three independent statistically calibrated errors.

depths.interpretation: Record two local depth spans separately. The 280 mm reading is at the door-region ruler location in IMG_9834; it does not establish the maximum of the entire curved front.
depths.constraint: Do not use the 13 mm difference as a measured curve radius or maximum bulge. Depth uncertainty was not specified by the user.

curved_front.status: User reports difficult to measure because front is not flat; not required as an independent arc-length constraint.
curved_front.next_fit: Fit curvature using existing RGB-D and photo outlines with the supplied transverse widths and local depths; constrain the left side to a plane and its edges to straight lines.

door_structure.upper: Front, left side and top panel move together around two vertical side hinges.
door_structure.lower: Front and left side move together around their own two vertical side hinges.
door_structure.fixed: Middle band and right control strip.

note: Confirmed readings are retained separately from approximate image-derived observations. No new collision mesh is generated by the measurement review script.
